translation: My younger sibling is very fat.
I want to use brushwood to make a fire.
It is I who beat that child.

form: n-udu maa kɨkɨ na vlisnɨ pwabreve.
translation: I will bring the wild pig back to the village.
I want to use this brushwood to make a fire.
As for me, I ate a banana.
The snake did not bite me.

form: amwa ki takanaw kwanə na bələbələ.
translation: Takanao went to eat the banana.
I asked him to come tomorrow.
